title: Why Recomp
summary: Recomp is a training plan that pays attention. It adjusts to what you actually do, explains every change, and keeps you in control of your data.

items.title: A plan that responds
items.text: Your plan adjusts to your logged sessions, effort feedback and weekly check-ins. Each change is saved as a new plan version, so nothing shifts without a record.

items.title: A reason for every change
items.text: When a weight goes up, a set is added or a session moves, Recomp tells you why in plain words, based on what you logged.

items.title: Reps count as progress
items.text: With double progression, doing more repetitions at the same weight is recognised as progress before the load increases.

items.title: Training, food and recovery together
items.text: Workouts, stretch and recovery routines, nutrition targets, a suggested meal plan and an intake log sit in one place, alongside sleep and activity from Garmin files you import.

items.title: A weekly reflection
items.text: A short weekly check-in and review covers what went well, what needs attention and what to change next. Your written updates are part of it.

items.title: AI help with wording, if you want it
items.text: You can turn on AI-assisted wording for your weekly review. The app calculates the numbers; the AI only phrases them. It is off by default and is not a qualified human trainer.

items.title: You control your data
items.text: Export your data, delete your account, choose whether an assigned coach can see your records, and protect your sign-in with two-step verification.

items.title: Recipes library
items.text: Recipes that fit your targets. Today Recomp offers targets, a suggested meal plan and an intake log.

items.title: Automatic wearable sync
items.text: Syncing without downloading files. Today you import Garmin files yourself.

items.title: Reminders
items.text: Push reminders for sessions and check-ins.

items.title: Set your goals
items.text: Choose your goal, the days and time you have, and your equipment.

items.title: Follow your plan
items.text: Train with clear targets for each exercise, with written cues and simple diagrams.

items.title: Log and reflect
items.text: Record your sets and effort, add written updates, and answer a short weekly check-in.

items.title: Review and adapt
items.text: See what changed and why, accept the changes you agree with, and start the next week.

items: Results depend on many things outside any app. Recomp does not promise a particular outcome.
Nutrition targets are estimates from simple formulas, not measurements.
Recomp does not give medical advice. If you have pain, an injury or a health condition, speak with a qualified health professional.
Planned features are ideas we intend to build. They are not available yet and may change.

blocks.text: Learn more [about Recomp](#about) or read the [privacy policy](#privacy).
